name: Frost Thread
description: Pull a single thin thread of frost out of the palm and flick it across the target's hand.

name: Ice Cord
description: Twist frost into a short cord and loop it round a wrist to hold the arm for a moment.

name: Rime Disc
description: Spin a flat disc of rime in the palm and send it low across the shins of one target.

name: Weave Hold
description: Hold a woven mesh of frost steady between two hands so that later shapes need less qi to form.

name: Hoar Veil
description: Fan a thin veil of frost between the user and one incoming strike.

name: Frost Whip
description: Snap a long lash of ice from the wrist that cracks against the target's arm or back.

name: Lash Bind
description: Whip a frost lash round the target's arm and pull so the cut and the tug land together.

name: Woven Screen
description: Weave many threads of frost into a hanging screen that stops darts and thrown knives.

name: Biting Slap
description: Slap a frost-bitten open hand across the face or shoulder to sting and shock.

name: Ice Rake
description: Drag clawed fingers downward in a trail of ice crystals to open long shallow welts.

name: Brand Cold
description: Hit with a fist that presses a deep cold mark into the target's torso.

name: Knuckle Rime
description: Coat the knuckles in rime just before a strike so the cold deepens through the blow.

name: Cold Flinch
description: Touch a pressure point with a cold fingertip so the muscle flinches and the strike goes wide.

name: Numbing Chain
description: Chain three quick cold blows along one arm until it hangs numb and cannot raise a guard.

name: Frostbite Seal
description: Freeze a cold fist onto the qi point at the wrist so the limb's flow of qi is held shut.

name: Rime Sheet
description: Spread a thin sheet of rime in front of the chest to catch a dart or a spat of fire.

name: Frost Lip
description: Raise a lip of ice from the floor so a running opponent trips over it.

name: Warning Rime
description: Lay a ring of fine rime on the ground and read the cracks where a heavy foot lands.

name: Cold Fan
description: Fan the hand across the front to throw a spray of cold mist over everyone standing close.

name: Chill Lean
description: Lean into a curved screen of ice and let a thrown knife skate off its face.

name: Thaw Check
description: Touch a melting patch and read how much heat passed there and how long ago.

name: Screen Rise
description: Raise a standing screen of thick rime that holds against arrows and light blows for several breaths.

name: Frost Arc
description: Sweep a wide arc of rime-edged cold along the ground to chill the legs of everyone ahead.

name: Frost Purge
description: Draw cold along an ally's arm to slow a spreading venom and press the poison out through the skin.

name: Held Cold
description: Hold a steady point of cold at the palm and keep it from rising or falling.

name: Sleet Fist
description: Strike with a fist wrapped in driving sleet that peppers the face and eyes.

name: Quiet Frost
description: Stand in a motionless guard while a still coat of frost forms over every blow it takes.

name: Hail Pellet
description: Hurl a hard pellet of hail from the open palm at the chest of one target.

name: Dull Chill
description: Let a dull chill sit on the target's chest until the quick breath slows and shortens.

name: Swift Slide
description: Throw a short slick of ice ahead and slide along it into reach.

name: Calm Burst
description: Release held cold in one burst of sleet that drives every opponent back from the user.

name: Stillness Strike
description: Freeze the stance for a breath and then strike with the held cold so the target cannot dodge.

name: Snap Frost
description: Snap the fingers against the target's wrist to spark a quick crust of ice.

name: Flash Ice
description: Glaze a bright sheet of ice in the opponent's eyeline to dazzle and mislead.

name: Quick Spike
description: Thrust a short spike of ice from the knuckles at an unarmoured gap.

name: Thin Shell
description: Snap a thin shell of ice round the forearm in the instant before impact.

name: Chill Dash
description: Burst forward on a short ice slick and stop sharply at arm's reach.

name: Ice Breath
description: Exhale a narrow jet of freezing air that stiffens the target's sleeves and fingers.

name: Chill Stanch
description: Freeze the lip of a wound with a cold fingertip to stanch the bleeding of an ally.

name: Burst Rime
description: Throw rime out from the whole body in one burst to sting and chill everyone close.

name: Fast Glaze
description: Glaze an opponent's lead leg in ice in a single motion to pin the stance.

name: Hard Snap
description: Snap a rime-hard palm upward under the chin so the head jolts and the guard opens.

name: Layered Frost
description: Lay thin layers of frost one upon another and harden each before laying the next.

name: Cold Temper
description: Temper a coat of cold across the chest until it rings like glass when struck.

name: Chill Compress
description: Pass a tempered cold palm over an ally's burn to quiet the heat and close the skin.

name: Chill Edge
description: Strike with a hand edged in hardened frost that bruises deep into muscle.

name: Frost Pace
description: Cross a patch of wet ground by freezing a firm footing under each step.

name: Hard Layer
description: Stack three layers of tempered frost over the arms to hold off a heavy blow without cracking.

name: Cold Salve
description: Chill an ally's festering cut with tempered cold so the taint stills and drains out with the blood.

name: Ice Knot
description: Tie an opponent's sleeve to the belt with a knot of ice so the arm cannot rise.

name: Frost Lock
description: Freeze a hand over the hilt of a drawn weapon so it cannot be cleared.

name: Rime Shackle
description: Close a ring of rime round the ankle to hold one foot to the ground.

name: Cold Grip
description: Clamp a freezing hand on the sword arm of the target and weigh it down.

name: Ice Glove
description: Close a glove of ice over the fist to guard the hand and add weight to the blow.

name: Free Crack
description: Strike a frozen bind at its seam so it shatters and lets a held ally go.

name: Shackle Pull
description: Bind both wrists in ice and yank the opponent off balance into a strike.

name: Rooted Ice
description: Freeze a weapon into the ground and hold it there while the user steps in.

name: Breaking Cold
description: Shatter a weapon the user has frozen with a single cold blow to the flat.
